purpose.summary: Add a public, dependency-locked GitHub-hosted ARM64 reproduction gate for the exact accepted ERGON-CHANGE-0010 legacy-compatibility matrix.
scope: Build the exact public baseline and technical candidate from fresh public clones in distinct roots on a fresh GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 22.04 ARM64 virtual machine.

Pin the Dockerfile frontend and Ubuntu container by immutable OCI digests, resolve the build profile from one signed Ubuntu archive snapshot, and record the complete installed package set and public build provenance.
Run the exact accepted ERGON-CHANGE-0010 matrix at commit 889212482c964ec98dcc2ac55321cb0e04e17666 and compare a positive allowlisted semantic projection against the existing public Observed report.
Keep both matrix reports Observed and emit only a proposed Reproduced comparison that requires separate external review before any evidence promotion.
exclusions: No production-node build-system or release-pipeline change, and no consensus, validation, P2P, storage, RPC, wallet, Chronik, activation, testnet, mainnet, or operator-binary change.
No modification of the accepted ERGON-CHANGE-0010 technical target, runner, scenarios, inherited test selection, or existing Observed report.
No deterministic-build, byte-identical-binary, historical-chain, public-network, sustained-operation, or mainnet-coexistence claim.
No incoming evidence, workflow artifact, proof promotion, private source, private history, operator material, host path, parent environment, secret, cache, binary, or datadir.

platforms: GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 22.04 ARM64 virtual machine with its mutable image identity recorded but excluded from deterministic-build claims
Digest-pinned Ubuntu 22.04 linux/arm64 container with packages resolved from the signed 20260901T000000Z Ubuntu archive snapshot

limitations: Publishing this tooling does not reproduce ERGON-CHANGE-0010; the exact hosted run, artifacts, comparison, and external review remain future work.

The GitHub-hosted virtual-machine image is mutable and is recorded at execution time; the digest-pinned container and signed Ubuntu snapshot lock the reproduction userland, not the host kernel or service.

The reproduction can establish semantic agreement for the bounded synthetic regtest matrix only; it does not claim deterministic or byte-identical builds, operator-binary equivalence, historical-chain replay, public-network peering, sustained operation, or mainnet coexistence.
Workflow artifacts expire and are not durable evidence until separately reviewed and committed through an evidence-only change.
The ERGON-CHANGE-0010 report remains Observed with an assembled-component ceiling until a separate accepted evidence promotion binds an independent successful execution.
counterevidence: The comparator self-test and local digest-pinned container preflight validate the method only; they are maintainer-environment observations and not independent reproduction.

A semantic match allows only Git version, current origin/main object, binary sizes and hashes, and config hashes to differ; every consensus, scenario, lineage, selection, signature, privacy, or claim difference fails closed.
Even a successful hosted comparison cannot establish mainnet coexistence, operator binary parity, deterministic builds, or behavior outside the four exact accepted scenarios.
